description: JavaScript/TypeScript charts and maps: XY, pie, maps with 670+ geodata maps, stock, Gantt, hierarchy, flow (Sankey, chord), radar, timeline, word cloud, Venn. Canvas or SVG. Charts can be built from JSON configs. Free with a small logo; a licence removes it.
rules: Use amCharts 5 only: no am4core, am4charts or am5.create(). Every object is made with ClassName.new(root, { ... }), never with new.
Create one root per element with am5.Root.new("chartdiv"); the element needs a height. Call root.dispose() on unmount or before making another root in the same element.
Colors and percents are objects: am5.color(0xff0000) and am5.percent(50), not strings.
Every axis needs a renderer, e.g. renderer: am5xy.AxisRendererX.new(root, {}). A category axis needs the data too: xAxis.data.setAll(data).
Date axes take timestamps and need a baseInterval; for date strings set series.data.processor = am5.DataProcessor.new(root, { dateFields: ["date"], dateFormat: "yyyy-MM-dd" }).
Set data last, after series, axes and templates are configured. Style through settings and templates (series.columns.template.setAll({ ... })), not CSS.
In React, Vue, Angular and Svelte prefer the official packages in integrations/ (@amcharts/amcharts5-react and so on).
amCharts 5 is free for commercial use as long as the amCharts logo stays on the chart; a commercial licence removes it.
